label: Finding-124
title: The BBC's 'roughly 70_' is not Wiz's wording
description: The BBC live page (bbc-live-ckgel5xp2xv9t, 08:05 UTC capture) puts 'roughly 70%' in quotation marks as Wiz's estimate. Wiz's blog and X post say '70% of all websites' and '70% of the Internet'; neither says 'roughly'. Anything on the site that quotes the BBC's phrase as Wiz's would be a quote of a quote.

comments.author: cli-user
comments.text: Run-3: Fixed in v0.13.0: the claim's 'by' now says the BBC reports it as Wiz's 'roughly 70_'.
